stem.en: How do the numbers of particles in one mole of helium and one mole of iron compare?
stem.et: Kuidas on omavahel seotud osakeste arv ühes moolis heeliumis ja ühes moolis rauas?

label.en: They are equal — one mole always contains the same number of entities
label.et: Need on võrdsed — üks mool sisaldab alati sama arvu osakesi

label.en: Iron has more, since a mole is a fixed mass and iron atoms are heavier
label.et: Rauas on rohkem, sest mool on kindel mass ja rauaaatomid on raskemad

label.en: Helium has more, because gases contain more particles than solids
label.et: Heeliumis on rohkem, sest gaasid sisaldavad rohkem osakesi kui tahked ained

label.en: They cannot be compared, since molar mass has different units for each
label.et: Neid ei saa võrrelda, sest moolimassil on kummagi jaoks eri ühikud
